A '''[[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] Lead''' was a discussion tactic in which one party made a rude and disparaging comment about an aspect under discussion, in an attempt to trick the other party into revealing more than they wished to divulge.<ref name="Dark Nest III">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
